thread:
Jordan (Finance): Heads up — NimbleApps just reported they were emailed two invoices with the same invoice number INV-2210 for 2024-04-01. One PDF has full usage lines, the other only has Taxes and Total. Both show paid in Stripe. Filed FIN-3890.
Priya (Billing): ack. Did we dedupe by invoice_number when generating PDFs? That shouldn't happen. Can you forward the two invoice IDs?
Rita (Support): customer supplied both attachments, filenames: invoice_INV-2210.pdf and invoice_INV-2210-copy.pdf. They look different.
Jordan (Finance): Pasted invoice metadata from our export: 
```
INV-2210 (doc_id: d_778) - status: paid - lines: [usage: $2,450.00, support: $200.00, tax: $258.00]
INV-2210-dup (doc_id: d_779) - status: paid - lines: [tax: $258.00, total: $2,908.00]
```
Alex (Eng Billing): thanks. That's trying to ring a bell — we deployed a queue worker upgrade last night (billing-queue v3) that switched to async batch windowing. There was a retry storm when the rendering job timed out; looks like the render step retried without preserving the idempotency key.
Billing Bot: Ticket FIN-3890 created and assigned to Priya (Billing).
Sam (SRE): I pulled logs: billing-renderer job 2024-04-02T02:14Z attempted doc d_778, timed out at 5s, retried and created d_779 at 02:14:06Z. Worker definitely requeued without idempotency header x-bill-id.
Priya (Billing): OK mitigation: I'll void d_779 and create a single consolidated credit/void then reissue a canonical PDF. But customer already paid twice in Stripe? Stripe shows two payment_intent IDs.
StripeWebhook: payment_intent.succeeded for pi_4K2a (amount 2908.00) linked to d_779; payment_intent.succeeded for pi_4K1z (amount 2908.00) linked to d_778.
Alex (Eng Billing): The amounts matching is odd — both total to same amount because d_779 missing usage lines but still calculated total using cached total value. Root cause: partial render wrote tax+total before usage lines were attached. Retry created a second doc with same invoice_number but different lines.
Jordan (Finance): Action list? We need minimal customer impact — don't issue two refunds if they meant to pay once.
Priya (Billing): Plan: 1) Void d_779 and post credit memo CM-701. 2) Refund the duplicate Stripe payment pi_4K2a once legal approves. 3) Reissue canonical invoice INV-2210-final (doc d_780) with the correct full lines and send apology note. 4) Add reconciler job to detect same invoice_number with multiple docs.
Rita (Support): customer ok with a single corrected invoice + refund; asked for ETA.
Sam (SRE): I'll add an alert: if invoice_number appears >1 within 24h, page on P1. Also adding idempotency header enforcement to render workers as emergency patch.
Alex (Eng Billing): hotfix ready: billing-renderer now requires x-bill-id and refuses to create a new doc if invoice_number exists in DB within last hour. Deploying to prod in 15m. Also writing data cleanup to merge any docs where total matches and only lines differ.
Jordan (Finance): Please include in the FIN-3890 ticket the full list of affected customers in last 7 days. We should check for similar partial renders causing missing line-items.
Priya (Billing): Running query now and will attach CSV to the ticket. Preparing email template and refund approval request.
Jordan (Finance): Approve refund up to $5k for NimbleApps. If refund >$5k we escalate.
Rita (Support): forwarding customer's confirmation. They prefer direct refund to card.
Billing Bot: FIN-3890 updated: status=investigating, assignee=Priya (Billing), labels=[duplicate-invoice, idempotency].
Jordan (Finance): Thanks team. Keep this thread updated with refund transaction ID and the reissued invoice PDF. :pray:
